Name: JAC'd - Coops
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
[b]Just Another Custom Deluxe: Coops[/b]

[b][UPDATE]

[/b]After all of these years, I have returned to fix what I have let go to waste for soo long. Special thanks to PathosChild for helping me adjust to the Content Patcher learning curve. I couldn't have done it without him!

[b][OLD NEWS][/b]

A custom deluxe coop for your Starry-doozlin' chickies and duckens. If you previously downloaded my other mod, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/455/]JAC'd [Just Another Custom Deluxe] - Barns[/url], you will need to download the new version as the tilesheet it relies on has been changed.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RCwV1ssl.jpg[/img]

[b][UPDATE]:[/b] Medium coops added! (Coop2.xnb). Tilesheet was also updated. New version includes Coop3.xnb (alternate version).

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ep962IDl.gif[/img]

[b][UPDATE]:[/b] Alternate version added.

[b][ALTERNATE VERSION]: [/b](Better Troughs, 2 pixels smaller.)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/MKL0AXgl.jpg[/img]
Note that [url=http://i.imgur.com/CzTXwdHh.jpg]this tile[/url] from above was actually fixed prior to release.

[b][PREVIOUS VERSION]: (OUTDATED | ABANDONED)[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zjcf9N5l.jpg[/img]
The [url=http://i.imgur.com/qgJNO2Mh.jpg]shadow tiles[/url] in the top-right were fixed prior to release.

NOTE: This mod requires [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-advanced-location-loader.114124/]Advanced Location Loader[/url] by [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/entoarox.624175/]Entoarox[/url].
